parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number, starting from 1. The default is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. The default is 10.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Filter by sending status.

- 0: Checking.

- 1: Check successful.

- 2: Check failed.

- 3: Sending.

- 4: Send successful.

- 5: Send failed.
